name: AgentTimeIcon
source_reference: agent-time-icon.origin.png, selected generated slate-blue icon concept; original violet branching clock inspected for structural intent. The source is a presentation board, not a production asset.
brief: An editable slate-blue branching clock. Open C dial, three flowing branches with circular terminals, orange human branch, blue agent branches, white hands and pivot on deep navy. Follow concept identity and palette with clean base geometry; defer generated glow and bevel material.

semantic_review.basis: Independent parent-agent visual review accepted whole-icon silhouette, balanced placement and spacing, three distinct node terminals, color roles and 64px recognition. This is a clean editable semantic interpretation, not strict pixel reproduction of the generated illustration.
semantic_review.notes: Semantic paths and simple arcs/circles remain editable. All strokes are outlined as clean filled geometry.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: Preserve the open C-shaped clock and three smooth right-hand branches, blue outside and orange middle.
must_preserve: white central pivot and two clock hands
three smooth branches ending in circles
top and bottom blue branches and orange middle branch
